newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gigante raised to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gigante raised to hold.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said Wednesday it had raised its rating for Mexican retailer Grupo Gigante to hold from underperform.
-- The upgrade was "based on an improved cash flow strategy," the firm said in a report.
-- "Grupo Gigante's investment thesis is directly related to an eventual turnaround which now seems more imminent."
-- "... Gigante's turnaround needs a few more signals before we can fully recommend this stock."
-- The company's B shares were down 0.02 peso at 2.22 pesos in Mexico City.
